images.prompt: Create an original hand-painted blue-white FROST projectile VFX animation sprite sheet. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff — do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or grid lines. Hand-drawn painted 2D animation, clean painted material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous grain. Flat pure black #000000 emission background; angular translucent ice facets, a bright white-blue core, deep cobalt soft emission fringes; no green or cyan; no text; every effect fully contained with ample black margins. Module IMPACT, square 1254×1254 sheet, strict 2×2 layout of equal 627×627 cells without visible dividing lines, row-major: four successive initial frames of an ice-lance collision centred at exactly 50%,50% of each cell: top-left frame 0 a tiny compact white crystalline flash, 15% of the cell; top-right frame 1 an explosive white-blue jagged burst, 35%; bottom-left frame 2 the peak radial icy explosion, 65%, angular outward shards; bottom-right frame 3 the burst breaking into several large flying shards with a diminishing central flash, 75%. Keep everything inside 8% cell margins; no circular disc or square, no black outlines, no smoke. Only four isolated effects on pure black.

references.role: STYLE ONLY — frost energy at the staff tip

concerns: Visual inspection suggests effect sizes exceed the requested cell percentages, especially frame 2, which also appears to intrude into the required 8% margins. No authorized retry condition was observed.
